descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum dissectum 'Germaine's Gyration' Large Cascading Germaine's Gyration Contorted Laceleaf Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 ‘Germaine’s Gyration’ is an excellent pendulous dissectum that has an unusual twisting growth habit. This Japanese maple tree selection naturally contorts as it grows creating very intricate spirals. This unique effect is magnified by the lateral branching. ‘Germaine’s Gyration’ has a larger leaf than most laceleaf Japanese maples reaching 10 ft in height by 15 ft in width in 20 years. Early spring color is a light green which merges to bright shades of yellow and orange throughout the autumn months. This Japanese maple was named after Germaine Iseli and has also been known as "Contorta" because of its unique contorting habit. descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum dissectum 'Germaine's Gyration' 大型下垂型扭曲羽裂日本枫，适生分区 5-9。 'Germaine's Gyration' 是一个极佳的下垂型羽裂日本枫，具有不同寻常的扭曲生长习性。 该品种在生长过程中会自然扭转，形成非常复杂的螺旋结构，而其横向分枝又进一步强化了这种独特效果。 'Germaine's Gyration' 的叶片比多数羽裂日本枫更大，20 年内可达 10 英尺高、15 英尺宽。 早春叶色为浅绿色，到了秋季会转为明亮的黄色和橙色。 这个日本枫以 Germaine Iseli 命名，也曾因其独特的扭曲习性而被称作“Contorta”。
